data.body:
CLOSING. The completion verifier previously blocked this close on ONE unmet criterion — "a test
asserts _verifier_cfg resolves the standard class, exercised through its real callers at
xcheck.py:198 and xcheck.py:336 rather than in isolation" — and that gap is now filled and CI-green.

EVIDENCE:
- Gerrit change 1119 (commit ef060e80d, the implementation): Verified +1, LLM-Review +1, submittable.
- Gerrit change 1128 (commit f7613bde6, the missing tests): Verified +1. This is the change that
  actually satisfies the criterion; 1119's +1 never covered it, which is why I held this close open
  rather than closing on 1119 alone.

WHY THE GAP WAS REAL, not a documentation gap — checked before writing anything: tests/unit/
test_verifier_class.py had 4 tests, all calling _verifier_cfg directly or going through
completion._verifier_model_for_completion; and tests/unit/test_plan_review_xcheck.py does reach
maybe_apply_contradiction / maybe_apply_comment_trail but asserts only DROP behaviour (which findings
survive), never the model the sub-call runs under. Those are independent properties: a caller passing
plain cfg instead of _verifier_cfg(cfg) would leave Pass-2/Pass-4 on the frontier model while every
isolated test stayed green — exactly the silent-inheritance defect this ticket exists to remove.

WHAT 1128 ADDS: two tests driving the REAL entries with a recording runner that captures each
RunRequest's config. Both sub-calls build RunRequest(config=_verifier_cfg(cfg)), so the captured model
IS what the verifier path runs under.
  test_contradiction_xcheck_resolves_standard_through_its_real_caller
  test_comment_trail_xcheck_resolves_standard_through_its_real_caller

VACUOUS-PASS GUARDS, because both entries are inert by default: each test enables its specific config
gate (contradiction_xcheck_active / comment_trail_xcheck_active); the comment-trail test supplies a
non-empty ctx.state["comments"] because that entry returns early with no trail; and each test asserts
the sub-call ACTUALLY RAN (rr.seen_models non-empty) BEFORE asserting what it ran on.

TEETH VERIFIED, not assumed: mutating both call sites from config=vcfg to config=cfg turns both tests
red with the leaked id in the message — "contradiction xcheck ran on ['anthropic:claude-opus-4-8']".
cfg.model is a provider-qualified frontier id in one test and a Bedrock frontier id in the other, so
the assertion also covers the provider-qualified case the original equality heuristic missed.

1128 was filed as a FOLLOW-UP COMMIT rather than an amend of ef060e80d because that commit sits
mid-stack and this environment has no interactive rebase. Both commits carry the rebar-ticket trailer
for this ticket.

NOTE for landing: 1128 is Verified +1 but NOT yet submittable — LLM-Review has not voted on it. The
close criterion is Verified +1; submit additionally needs LLM-Review +1, so 1128 must not be
submitted until the review bot votes.
